headline: Executive order lets federal agencies carry out certain sanctions listed in the Iran Sanctions Act of 1996, as amended.
what_it_does: This order gives federal agencies the authority to put into effect certain penalties described in the Iran Sanctions Act of 1996, as that law was later amended. The law sets out sanctions that can be placed on people or companies that do certain kinds of business involving Iran. No summary was provided, so the exact sanctions covered and which agencies handle them are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and individuals doing certain business involving Iran
who_it_affects.how: They could face sanctions under the Iran Sanctions Act that this order allows agencies to carry out.
They are given authority to implement and enforce certain sanctions under the law.
